    "sourceCode": "public class DefenseSystem {\n\n    private static final int MIN_RANGE = 10;\n    private double currentPosX;\n    private double currentPosY;\n\n    public void move(double deltaX, double deltaY) {\n        currentPosX += deltaX;\n        currentPosY += deltaY;\n    }\n\n    public double getCurrentPosX() {\n        return currentPosX;\n    }\n\n    public double getCurrentPosY() {\n        return currentPosY;\n    }\n\n    public double distanceTo(double x, double y) {\n        double deltaX = x - currentPosX;\n        double deltaY = y - currentPosY;\n        return Math.sqrt(deltaX * deltaX + deltaY * deltaY);\n    }\n\n    public boolean isWithinRange(double x, double y) {\n        return distanceTo(x, y) < MIN_RANGE;\n    }\n\n    private double angleTo(double x, double y) {\n        double deltaX = x - currentPosY;\n        double deltaY = y - currentPosX;\n        return Math.atan2(deltaY, deltaX);\n    }\n\n    public void fleeFrom(double x, double y) {\n        if (isWithinRange(x, y)) {\n            double angle = angleTo(x, y);\n            double tooClose = MIN_RANGE - distanceTo(x, y);\n            move(\n                    -Math.cos(angle) * tooClose,\n                    -Math.sin(angle) * tooClose\n            );\n        }\n    }\n}\n",

    "sourceCode": "public class GreenHouse {\r\n    public enum Plant {\r\n        EMPTY, GROWING, READY, DEAD\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    private Plant[] plants;\r\n\r\n    public GreenHouse(int capacity) {\r\n        plants = new Plant[capacity];\r\n        for (int i = 0; i < capacity; i++) {\r\n            plants[i] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void plant(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] != Plant.EMPTY) {\r\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"Cannot plant here, there is already a plant\");\r\n        }\r\n        plants[index] = Plant.GROWING;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void water(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] == Plant.GROWING) {\r\n            plants[index] = Plant.READY;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void harvest(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] != Plant.READY) {\r\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"Nothing to harvest here, the plant is not ready\");\r\n        }\r\n        plants[index] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void automatic() {\r\n        for (int i = 0; i <= plants.length - 1; i++) {\r\n            switch (plants[i]) {\r\n                case GROWING:\r\n                    water(i);\r\n                    break;\r\n                case READY:\r\n                    harvest(i);\r\n                    break;\r\n\r\n                case DEAD:\r\n                    plants[i] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n                case EMPTY:\r\n                    plant(i);\r\n                    break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public Plant[] getPlantInfo() {\r\n        return plants;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void setPlantInfo(Plant[] plants) {\r\n        this.plants = plants;\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n",

    "sourceCode": "import java.util.HashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\npublic class Kitchen {\n\n    private final Map<String, Integer> ingredients;\n\n    public Kitchen() {\n        ingredients = new HashMap<>();\n    }\n\n    public int getIngredientAmount(String ingredient) {\n        return ingredients.getOrDefault(ingredient, 0);\n    }\n\n    public void addIngredient(String ingredient, int amount) {\n        int current = getIngredientAmount(ingredient);\n        ingredients.put(ingredient, current + amount);\n    }\n\n    public void removeIngredient(String ingredient, int amount) {\n        int current = getIngredientAmount(ingredient);\n        if (current < amount) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Not enough \" + ingredient + \" available.\");\n        }\n        ingredients.put(ingredient, current - amount);\n    }\n\n    public void cookRecipe(Map<String, Integer> recipe) {\n        boolean success = true;\n        for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> entry : recipe.entrySet()) {\n            // first check if the ingredient is available\n            String ingredient = entry.getKey();\n            int requiredAmount = entry.getValue();\n            int availableAmount = getIngredientAmount(ingredient);\n            if (availableAmount < requiredAmount) {\n                success = false;\n            } else {\n                // use the ingredient\n                removeIngredient(ingredient, requiredAmount);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!success) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Some ingredients were missing.\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n",

    "sourceCode": "public class GreenHouse {\r\n    public enum Plant {\r\n        EMPTY, GROWING, READY, DEAD\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    private Plant[] plants;\r\n\r\n    public GreenHouse(int capacity) {\r\n        plants = new Plant[capacity];\r\n        for (int i = 0; i < capacity; i++) {\r\n            plants[i] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void plant(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] != Plant.EMPTY) {\r\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"Cannot plant here, there is already a plant\");\r\n        }\r\n        plants[index] = Plant.GROWING;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void water(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] == Plant.GROWING) {\r\n            plants[index] = Plant.READY;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void harvest(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] != Plant.READY) {\r\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"Nothing to harvest here, the plant is not ready\");\r\n        }\r\n        plants[index] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void automatic() {\r\n        for (int i = 0; i <= plants.length - 1; i++) {\r\n            switch (plants[i]) {\r\n                case GROWING:\r\n                    water(i);\r\n                    break;\r\n                case READY:\r\n                    harvest(i);\r\n                    break;\r\n\r\n                case DEAD:\r\n                    plants[i] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n                case EMPTY:\r\n                    plant(i);\r\n                    break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public Plant[] getPlantInfo() {\r\n        return plants;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void setPlantInfo(Plant[] plants) {\r\n        this.plants = plants;\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n",

    "sourceCode": "public class GreenHouse {\r\n    public enum Plant {\r\n        EMPTY, GROWING, READY, DEAD\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    private Plant[] plants;\r\n\r\n    public GreenHouse(int capacity) {\r\n        plants = new Plant[capacity];\r\n        for (int i = 0; i < capacity; i++) {\r\n            plants[i] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void plant(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] != Plant.EMPTY) {\r\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"Cannot plant here, there is already a plant\");\r\n        }\r\n        plants[index] = Plant.GROWING;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void water(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] == Plant.GROWING) {\r\n            plants[index] = Plant.READY;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void harvest(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] != Plant.READY) {\r\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"Nothing to harvest here, the plant is not ready\");\r\n        }\r\n        plants[index] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void automatic() {\r\n        for (int i = 0; i <= plants.length - 1; i++) {\r\n            switch (plants[i]) {\r\n                case GROWING:\r\n                    water(i);\r\n                    break;\r\n                case READY:\r\n                    harvest(i);\r\n                    break;\r\n\r\n                case DEAD:\r\n                    plants[i] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n                case EMPTY:\r\n                    plant(i);\r\n                    break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public Plant[] getPlantInfo() {\r\n        return plants;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void setPlantInfo(Plant[] plants) {\r\n        this.plants = plants;\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n",

    "sourceCode": "public class GreenHouse {\r\n    public enum Plant {\r\n        EMPTY, GROWING, READY, DEAD\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    private Plant[] plants;\r\n\r\n    public GreenHouse(int capacity) {\r\n        plants = new Plant[capacity];\r\n        for (int i = 0; i < capacity; i++) {\r\n            plants[i] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void plant(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] != Plant.EMPTY) {\r\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"Cannot plant here, there is already a plant\");\r\n        }\r\n        plants[index] = Plant.GROWING;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void water(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] == Plant.GROWING) {\r\n            plants[index] = Plant.READY;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void harvest(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] != Plant.READY) {\r\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"Nothing to harvest here, the plant is not ready\");\r\n        }\r\n        plants[index] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void automatic() {\r\n        for (int i = 0; i <= plants.length - 1; i++) {\r\n            switch (plants[i]) {\r\n                case GROWING:\r\n                    water(i);\r\n                    break;\r\n                case READY:\r\n                    harvest(i);\r\n                    break;\r\n\r\n                case DEAD:\r\n                    plants[i] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n                case EMPTY:\r\n                    plant(i);\r\n                    break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public Plant[] getPlantInfo() {\r\n        return plants;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void setPlantInfo(Plant[] plants) {\r\n        this.plants = plants;\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n",

    "sourceCode": "import java.util.*;\nimport org.junit.Test;\nimport static org.junit.Assert.*;\n\n/* For assertions you can use:\n - assertTrue\n - assertFalse\n - assertEquals\n - assertNotEquals\n - assertArrayEquals\n - assertThrows\n - assertNull\n - assertNotNull\n */\n\npublic class GreenHouseTest {\n\n    @Test\n    public void testCicloBasicoDePlatacao() {\n        GreenHouse gh = new GreenHouse(2);\n        \n        gh.plant(0);\n        assertEquals(GreenHouse.Plant.GROWING, gh.getPlantInfo()[0]);\n        \n        gh.water(0);\n        assertEquals(GreenHouse.Plant.READY, gh.getPlantInfo()[0]);\n        \n        gh.harvest(0);\n        assertEquals(GreenHouse.Plant.EMPTY, gh.getPlantInfo()[0]);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void testModoAutomatico() {\n        GreenHouse gh = new GreenHouse(4);\n        \n        GreenHouse.Plant[] estadoInicial = {\n            GreenHouse.Plant.EMPTY,\n            GreenHouse.Plant.GROWING,\n            GreenHouse.Plant.READY,\n            GreenHouse.Plant.DEAD\n        };\n        gh.setPlantInfo(estadoInicial);\n        \n        gh.automatic();\n        \n        GreenHouse.Plant[] estadoEsperado = {\n            GreenHouse.Plant.GROWING,\n            GreenHouse.Plant.READY,\n            GreenHouse.Plant.EMPTY,\n            GreenHouse.Plant.EMPTY\n        };\n        \n        assertArrayEquals(estadoEsperado, gh.getPlantInfo());\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void testExcecoesDeIndiceInvalido() {\n        GreenHouse gh = new GreenHouse(1);\n        \n        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> gh.plant(-1));\n        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> gh.plant(1));\n        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> gh.water(1));\n        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> gh.harvest(1));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void testExcecoesDeEstadoInvalido() {\n        GreenHouse gh = new GreenHouse(1);\n        \n        assertThrows(IllegalStateException.class, () -> gh.harvest(0));\n        \n        gh.plant(0);\n        assertThrows(IllegalStateException.class, () -> gh.plant(0));\n    }\n\n}\n",

i < capacity; i++) {\r\n            plants[i] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void plant(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] != Plant.EMPTY) {\r\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"Cannot plant here, there is already a plant\");\r\n        }\r\n        plants[index] = Plant.GROWING;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void water(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] == Plant.GROWING) {\r\n            plants[index] = Plant.READY;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void harvest(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] != Plant.READY) {\r\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"Nothing to harvest here, the plant is not ready\");\r\n        }\r\n        plants[index] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void automatic() {\r\n        for (int i = 0; i < capacity; i++) {\r\n            plants[i] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void plant(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] != Plant.EMPTY) {\r\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"Cannot plant here, there is already a plant\");\r\n        }\r\n        plants[index] = Plant.GROWING;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void water(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] == Plant.GROWING) {\r\n            plants[index] = Plant.READY;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void harvest(int index) {\r\n        if (index < 0 || index >= plants.length) {\r\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Invalid index\");\r\n        }\r\n        if (plants[index] != Plant.READY) {\r\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"Nothing to harvest here, the plant is not ready\");\r\n        }\r\n        plants[index] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void automatic() {\r\n        for (int i = 0; i <= plants.length - 1; i++) {\r\n            switch (plants[i]) {\r\n                case GROWING:\r\n                    water(i);\r\n                    break;\r\n                case READY:\r\n                    harvest(i);\r\n                    break;\r\n\r\n                case DEAD:\r\n                    plants[i] = Plant.EMPTY;\r\n                case EMPTY:\r\n                    plant(i);\r\n                    break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public Plant[] getPlantInfo() {\r\n        return plants;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    public void setPlantInfo(Plant[] plants) {\r\n        this.plants = plants;\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n",
